sample.title: This Black Friday, adults are buying toys for themselves | The Global Story
sample.description:
The toy industry calls them ‘kidults’, and in the last few years they’ve become a rapidly growing market. In the US, adult-only households made up the majority of toy sales in the first half of 2026.

And it’s not just toys – across the media landscape adults are reconnecting with films and games that were traditionally marketed towards children. Is all this just harmless fun, or is ‘kidulting’ a form of arrested development?

We speak to the New Yorker‘s Diego Lasarte, who has written about why adults are buying so many toys, and to the self-professed ‘Disney adult’ AJ Wolfe.

sample.title: Inside mission to grab some of Mars' moondust | BBC News
sample.description:
The first images of an asteroid Nasa deliberately crashed into have revealed a stadium-sized crater on its surface.
 
A mission was sent to assess the damage caused when the Nasa spacecraft hit the asteroid Dimorphos in 2022. The asteroid posed no threat, but this was a test of our planetary defences to see if it was possible to knock a space rock off course.
 
Meanwhile, after an eight-year journey, a mission has reached the closest planet to the Sun - Mercury.
 
And a spacecraft is also on its way to Mars to grab a piece of its moon and bring it back to Earth.

sample.title: Train attack driver's '10 seconds' to change line | BBC News
